prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.AI** looks like a good starting point: it monitors whether your business appears in answers from ChatGPT and several other AI search services, and tracks mentions and website citations. Its entry plan is listed at **about $29/month**, with a free trial; check its current pricing and trial terms before signing up.

Set up prompts that resemble real customer questions, such as “best [your service] in [your town]” and “who can help with [customer need] near me.” Track a handful of these, along with competitor names, and review the actual answers—not just a visibility score.

One caveat: AI answers can vary from one query or day to another, so no monitoring service can guarantee a definitive answer to “does ChatGPT recommend my business?” Treat the results as a trend, and occasionally test the same questions directly in ChatGPT.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
